modules.shared/launcher-resources.mjs: Pure owned resource snapshot and strict read, path/tree/byte budgets and per-file MD5; bounded canonical non-secret binding identity.
modules.shared/index.mjs: Export resource format/error/binding/owned snapshot APIs without platform dependencies.
modules.web/launcher-resource-store.mjs: One whole-snapshot native IndexedDB record, CAS revisions and completed-transaction flags; no installed-client filesystem.
modules.web/launcher-patch-state.mjs: copySelectedResources and explicit review-only exact-binding restore; owned payloads and reset invalidation.
modules.web/login-patch-cache.mjs: Explicit check/save/restore/cancel, matching current configuration, controlled errors, generation/deadline lifecycle.
modules.web/login-patch.mjs: Compose cache controls and patch state; aggregate busy state; cache restoration still needs choice.
modules.web/login-app.mjs: Cache-aware busy status and no process preparation while cache is busy.
modules.web/login.html: Collapsed own-cache controls with explicit byte persistence/replacement/source-trust disclosure.

classification: Entire cache format/storage/atomicity/readiness is independent implementation policy; no claim of original Windows storage/rollback behavior.

format.model: {schema:moli.launcher.resources.v1,binding,files:[{path,bytes:Uint8Array,md5}],trust:unverified}; no production JSON encoding of payloads.
format.binding: Exact gameListMd5/regionListMd5, original game/reference/region ordinals, original numeric Code text, canonical Windows-directory snapshot, explicit pathEncoding, optional original Galaxy ordinal. Only these fields picked from catalog plan; extra account/display fields never copied.
format.canonical: Lowercase full32hex catalog MD5; own finite integer ordinals0..signed32max; Code digits <=4096 chars with numeric0..14; localDirectoryPath and explicit ascii/windows-936/utf-8. Stored records must already be canonical and have exact keys; explicit undefinedGalaxy rejected.
format.files: Existing strict relativeASCII paths/casealiases/tree conflicts reused;1024files,32MiB each,64MiB total. True attached Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer; SharedArrayBuffer/DataView/getters/proxies unsupported; empty files/snapshots supported.
format.verification: Fresh owned copies and computed MD5 on creation; strict root/binding/file shape/path/tree/budget and all stored MD5 rechecked on read. Digests are corruption checks only, never source authentication.
format.identity: JSON.stringify of fixed-order selected binding fields; not an official format or protocol field.

store.namespace: moli-mac.launcher.resources.<explicit safe profile>; DBversion1; sole snapshots store, keyPath key, no autoIncrement/indexes; singleton key selected.
store.record: {key:selected,schema:1,revision:positive safe integer,resources:own-format snapshot}. Empty read returns revision0/resourcesnull. No timestamps/accounts/consent/auth state.
store.commit: Snapshot all input bytes before asynchronous open; read/verify existing record, CAS expectedRevision and one complete-record put in a single readwrite transaction. Completion event required before committed=true.
store.abort: Before native completion, abort preserves old record. Once completion is irreversible, report committed with cancellationTooLate/deadlineExceededAfterCommit rather than claim rollback. UI cancellation resets local operation but does not promise reversal.
store.bounded: One monotonic default10s/max60s deadline includes validation/open/transaction; actual AbortSignal; late successful open closes DB. Captured factory.open ignores later replacement.
store.refusal: Corrupt/unknown schema/future DB/version/foreign store shape/conflicts are retained and refused; no automatic delete/migration/overwrite. IO messages controlled.
store.limits: IndexedDB get materializes a structured clone before own validation. No quota reservation, power-failure durability, browser eviction protection, streaming/large-install coverage or native filesystem rollback.

UI.profile: login-patch-local on current browser origin; no automatic cache read/write or restore.
UI.save: Requires explicitly selected complete candidate and a checked revision; recheck current binding; replace only expected stored version. One binding snapshot per profile, not a full installation database.
UI.restore: Check current configuration/directory/encoding, load all-file validated snapshot, exact binding match then explicitly read into review-only candidate. Choice required again; file paths feed existing resources and owned bytes remain available through resource APIs.
UI.changed: Configuration/region/Galaxy/XML restore, directory/path encoding/base files/pagehide invalidate local cache references, cancel current operation and prevent late revival. Persisted record retained.
UI.metadata_only_DOM: Counts/relative names/version/status only; resource payloads go to IndexedDB, not DOM/Storage strings/network/account fields.
UI.locks: Cache activity shares patch busy gate. Failures preserve a valid in-page choice where applicable; no invisible downgrade to another target.
UI.capability: No new network source, runtime descriptor, original process or installed write; opt-in patch origin policy fromv28 unchanged.

state.copySelectedResources: Requires selected candidate, returns owned verified-format snapshot, no aliases into private candidate.
state.restore: Resets previous state first, validates stored format/digests and explicit expected binding, clones candidate files and enters ready/cache; never selected automatically; failure leaves no old readiness.

not_implemented: Native installation transaction/Win32 recovery and original source authenticity
Full-install size/streaming/cross-catalog migration of cached bases
Official service/accounts/opaque/game consumer and game implementation
run: node web/examples/launcher-browser-game-patch-local.mjs; save/check/restore before the one original exchange closes the example.
